roles.name: VP of Adjacent Concerns
roles.blurb: Enormous budget, three headcount, and zero credibility with anyone who writes code. Can buy anything. Cannot be believed. Every dialogue check against engineers is at a penalty, which the engineers would describe as calibrated.

roles.name: Staff Engineer
roles.blurb: Balanced. Knows where the forms are, which is why they can never leave. Starts with the Repair Loop ability: once per landmark, fix one broken system for free.

roles.name: Contractor, 6-Week Statement of Work
roles.blurb: No budget, no admin rights, and a laptop that arrives on week four. Cannot purchase anything at the Outfitting Store; must scavenge. Starts with read-only production access, which is somehow more than the full-time staff have.

assist.description: +2 tool calls in Bug Hunt. Unburdened by the memory of the last five ways this failed, which is occasionally the only way to find the sixth.

failureMode.description: Accepts the first plausible answer. Occasionally merges it.

assist.description: Reveals one hidden flaw in any loop before you run it. Has seen this exact mistake before, twice, and can name the year each time.

failureMode.description: Will not proceed without a design doc. Costs 1 day.

assist.description: Halves damage from Injection events. Notices the polite instruction addressed to your agent before your agent does.

failureMode.description: Blocks one purchase per landmark on principle. Is usually right.

assist.description: Converts 1 Morale into 1 Credibility per landmark. Makes the work visible to people who only believe in visible work.

failureMode.description: Schedules a ceremony during every crisis.
Are accountable for all of it.
